name: How long does it take to remove a bathtub?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove a bathtub?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathtub extraction typically takes between three to eight hours of active labor. Simple fiberglass alcove removals often take less than half a day. However, older cast iron tubs embedded behind thick plaster, wire mesh, or masonry mud beds can extend the removal into a full day. If the tub removal is part of an ongoing walk-in shower conversion or full remodel, subfloor inspections and plumbing rough-ins will add time to the broader project schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing an existing bathtub generally takes 3 to 8 hours, depending on whether the unit is lightweight acrylic or heavy cast iron set into mortar.
